findings.failureScenario: The denoise server counts a connection against max_connections (default 8) when it is accepted, before any token check, and each connection may stay idle for the full 120 s read timeout. Any host that can reach the port, without knowing the token, can open 8 connections and send nothing, repeating every 2 minutes. Every legitimate client then gets 'server busy', so the remote GPU is denied to its owner. The listener is meant for a LAN/VPN, which limits who can reach it.
findings.action: Apply a short pre-authentication deadline (for example a 5 s read timeout until the first valid token line), and only then switch to the full timeout. Optionally cap connections per peer IP.
